pricing.basis: OpenAI reference rates + user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates (uncached inputs)
pricing.source: OpenAI: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing; MAI: user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates applied to all MAI models
pricing.notes: GPT prices are public OpenAI reference rates, not verified Azure deployment prices. MAI-Image-2 starting rates are assumed for both MAI models at user request. No cache discounts, taxes, or negotiated discounts. Null means unavailable, not zero.
pricing.mai_rate_source: User-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates: $5 per 1M text-input tokens and $33 per 1M image-output tokens; apply to all MAI models.
pricing.mai_pricing_assumption: For estimation, price MAI num_output_tokens as image output. Raw response modality fields remain unchanged. Image-input pricing was not supplied; positive image-input tokens prevent a complete total.

results.prompt: Create a premium photorealistic studio product photograph for the fictional ORBIT brand. One matte terracotta ceramic mug with a single curved handle on its right, sitting on a pale stone plinth. The word ORBIT is printed clearly on the front in small ivory uppercase letters. Soft morning light from the upper left, believable contact shadow, fine ceramic texture, warm cream seamless background. Three-quarter camera view. Keep the entire mug visible with generous negative space. No additional objects or text.
results.total_tokens_basis: reported or sum of reported modality counts
